stages.name: Understand
stages.description: Learn how the business actually works, not how the org chart says it does.

stages.name: Diagnose
stages.description: Identify what is really holding the business back, beyond the symptoms.

stages.name: Clarify
stages.description: Agree what needs to change, what matters most, and what success looks like.

stages.name: Design
stages.description: Develop the strategy, structure, systems and ways of working needed to move forward.

stages.name: Execute
stages.description: Put the work into practice alongside the team that has to live with it.

stages.name: Strengthen
stages.description: Build the internal capability so the change holds without us in the room.

stages.name: Transform
stages.description: The business runs differently — and keeps running differently.
